fullTextEN: Hello everyone,
I am Teacher Wang,
I come from Henan, China.
Where is Henan?
Henan is in central China.
What does Henan have?
Henan has the Shaolin Temple,
Henan has Chinese Kung Fu.
Welcome to Henan.

fullTextZH: 上一次我给你们讲了一只猴子的故事，
fullTextEN: Last time I told you a story about a monkey,
It's called Sun Wukong.

fullTextZH: 这只猴子又聪明又有能力，
fullTextEN: This monkey is both smart and capable,

fullTextZH: 可是他不听神仙们的话，
fullTextEN: but he doesn't listen to the gods,

fullTextZH: 被一个很厉害的神仙压在了山下，
fullTextEN: and was pressed under a mountain by a very powerful god,

fullTextZH: 这位很厉害的神仙叫如来，
fullTextEN: This very powerful god is called Rulai,

fullTextZH: 如来住在很远很远很远的地方，
fullTextEN: Rulai lives in a very, very, very far place,
This mountain is called Wuxing Mountain.
This mountain is very, very, very tall,

fullTextZH: 山上有五种元素：金、木、水、火、土。
fullTextEN: On the mountain, there are five elements: metal, wood, water, fire, earth.

fullTextZH: 孙悟空被压在山下不能动已经 500年了。
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong has been pressed under the mountain unable to move for 500 years.
Although he is very powerful,

fullTextZH: 但是还有比他更厉害的人。
fullTextEN: there are still people more formidable than him.

fullTextZH: 离五行山很远很远的地方，
fullTextEN: Far, far away from the Five Elements Mountain,
there is a country,

fullTextZH: 有一天这个国家在开会，
fullTextEN: One day, this country was having a meeting,

fullTextZH: 国王希望他们的国家变得更好。
fullTextEN: The king hoped their country would become better.
One person said,

fullTextZH: 在很远很远很远的地方，
fullTextEN: In a very, very, very distant place,
lives a powerful immortal,
He is called Tathagata.

fullTextZH: 这个神仙家里有几本书，
fullTextEN: This immortal has some books at home,
After reading these books,

fullTextZH: 我们的国家就会变得更好。
fullTextEN: our country will become better.

fullTextZH: 国王就让唐僧去这个神仙家里拿书，
fullTextEN: The king then sent Tang Monk to get the books from this immortal's home,

fullTextZH: 唐僧想早点把书拿回来。
fullTextEN: Tang Monk wanted to bring the books back as soon as possible.
The next day,

fullTextZH: 他骑着一匹白马出发了。
fullTextEN: he set off riding a white horse.
Passing by the Five Elements Mountain,

fullTextZH: 唐僧听见了一个声音：师傅，
fullTextEN: Tang Monk heard a voice: Master,
Master!
Oh,
What is a master?
A master is a teacher,

fullTextZH: 我们可以和老师学很多东西，
fullTextEN: We can learn many things from teachers,
A master is also like a parent,
and can help us.
As for me,
I am a teacher,
not a master.
Tang Monk is a master,

fullTextZH: 这个声音是孙悟空在叫他。
fullTextEN: This voice is Sun Wukong calling him.
Tang Monk is very kind,
He wants to help Sun Wukong.

fullTextZH: 唐僧看着五行山说了几句话，
fullTextEN: Tang Monk looked at Five Elements Mountain and said a few words,
Five Elements Mountain slowly,
slowly moved,
Sun Wukong came out from under the mountain.
Sun Wukong is very grateful to Tang Monk,
Starting today,

fullTextZH: 孙悟空跟着唐僧一起去神仙家拿书。
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong follows Tang Monk to the immortal's home to get the scriptures.
They were walking along the road,
and saw a river.
Tang Seng said: Sun Wukong,
you haven't bathed for 500 years,
go take a bath quickly.

fullTextZH: 孙悟空一点也不听师傅的话，
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong didn't listen to his master at all,
Tang Seng was a bit angry.

fullTextZH: 它们走着走着又看见了一只老虎，
fullTextEN: They walked and walked and saw a tiger,
this tiger wanted to eat them.

fullTextZH: 孙悟空从耳朵里拿出金箍棒，
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong took out his golden staff from his ear,
and said 'big, big, big'.

fullTextZH: 金箍棒变得又长又大了，
fullTextEN: The golden staff became long and big,

fullTextZH: 孙悟空拿着金箍棒打老虎，
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong hit the tiger with the golden staff,
and the tiger died.
Tang Seng became even angrier,

fullTextZH: 他不想让孙悟空打死老虎，
fullTextEN: he didn't want Sun Wukong to kill the tiger,
Sun Wukong was so disobedient,
what to do?

fullTextZH: 晚上唐僧和孙悟空聊天，
fullTextEN: In the evening, Tang Seng chatted with Sun Wukong,
Tang Seng gave him a hat,
This hat is golden,
Very beautiful.
Sun Wukong likes it a lot,
so he wears it on his head,
but after putting on the hat,
his head hurt a lot,

fullTextZH: 帽子变成了一个金色的圆环，
fullTextEN: the hat turned into a golden ring,
Sun Wukong couldn't take it off,

fullTextZH: 这个时候他看见唐僧一直在说一句话：吃葡萄不吐葡萄皮，
fullTextEN: at this time he saw Tang Seng saying a phrase repeatedly: Eat grapes without spitting out the skins,
Eat grapes without spitting out the skins.
Tang Seng stopped talking,
his head stopped hurting.
Tang Seng told Sun Wukong,
in the future you must obey,
then your head won't hurt.

fullTextZH: 孙悟空害怕唐僧说吃葡萄不吐葡萄皮，
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong is afraid of Tang Seng saying eat grapes without spitting out the skins,
because his head will hurt.
From today onwards,
Sun Wukong is very obedient,
Tang Seng is happy every day.
Okay,

fullTextZH: 那王老师有几个问题要问你们。
fullTextEN: Mr. Wang has a few questions to ask you.

fullTextZH: 第一个问题是孙悟空在五行山下多少年？
fullTextEN: The first question is how many years was Sun Wukong under the Five Elements Mountain?

fullTextZH: 第二个问题是谁帮助了孙悟空？
fullTextEN: The second question is who helped Sun Wukong?

fullTextZH: 第三个问题是孙悟空不听话的时候，
fullTextEN: The third question is when Sun Wukong was disobedient,
What did Tang Monk do?

fullTextZH: 第四个问题是唐僧说吃葡萄不吐葡萄皮，
fullTextEN: The fourth question is Tang Monk said eating grapes without spitting the skin,
Eating grapes without spitting the skin,
What will happen to Sun Wukong?

fullTextZH: 王老师在等你的回答哦，
fullTextEN: Mr. Wang is waiting for your answer,
Goodbye!
